review.reason: The answer mostly stays within the cited passages and repeatedly flags that the evidence does not directly connect the A&D requirements to specific signaling/non-signaling tester models, options, KPIs, or pass/fail criteria. Some mappings are inferential—especially treating NTN conditions as A&D/non-signaling tester requirements and turning market drivers into measurable KPIs—but they are clearly caveated rather than presented as fully established facts.
